LESSON: HANDWRITING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.3: Handwriting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Handwriting
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you take care of classroom items?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify vocabulary on colours for language acquisition
2. write simple sentences using descriptive words in neat and legible handwriting
3. appreciate the skill of writing for effective communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Handwriting

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Handwriting

Teach
• Focus skill: identify vocabulary on colours for language acquisition.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Handwriting.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Handwriting
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you take care of classroom items?
2. Why is neat handwriting preferred in writing?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
